reports.title: Sarepta Therapeutics Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Corporate Developments

lines: Updates to 2026 guidance range include raising lower end of total net product revenue by $50.0 million, driven by strong PMO performance, and lowering higher end of expense by $25.0 million, reflecting operating discipline

The Company expects the PMO franchise to remain strong and is updating its full-year guidance ranges, raising the low end of total net product revenue guidance by $50.0 million to a range of $1.25 billion to $1.3 billion.
The Company also narrows its full-year combined non-GAAP R&D and SG&A expenses, lowering the high end of expense guidance by $25.0 million to a range of $800 million to $825 million.
